name: Star Wars: Visions
description: This anthology of animated shorts from around the world celebrates the mythos of Star Wars through unique cultural lenses.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - Origins
videos.overview: The team behind "Star Wars: Visions" reveals the origins of this groundbreaking anthology series.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - The Duel
videos.overview: Takanobu Mizuno and Junpei Mizusaki take us behind the scenes of "The Duel."

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - Tatooine Rhapsody
videos.overview: An inside look at the making of "Tatooine Rhapsody" featuring Director Taku Kimura.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - The Twins
videos.overview: Director Hiroyuki Imaishi of Trigger, Inc. highlights the epic, exaggerated battle of "The Twins."

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - Village Bride
videos.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the making of "The Village Bride," featuring Director Hitoshi Haga.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - The Ninth Jedi
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes on "The Ninth Jedi" with Director Kenji Kamiyama at Production I.G.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - T0-B1
videos.overview: Director Abel Gongora explores the retro-inspired origins of "T0-B1."

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - The Elder
videos.overview: Director Masahiko Otsuka reflects on his final film, TRIGGER Studios’ "The Elder."

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - Lop & Ochō
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes of the world of "Lop & Ochō" with director Yuki Igarashi.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus - Akakiri
videos.overview: Director Eunyoung Choi discusses the Kurosawa influences behind "Akakiri."

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | A Global Vision
videos.overview: The team behind "Star Wars: Visions Volume 2" discuss the second installment in the anthology.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "Sith"
videos.overview: Director Rodrigo Blaas of El Guiri Studios takes us behind the scenes of Sith.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "Screecher's Reach"
videos.overview: An inside look at the making of Screecher's Reach featuring Director Paul Young of Cartoon Saloon.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "In the Stars"
videos.overview: Join Director Gabriel Osorio and the Punk Robot team as they discuss In the Stars.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "I Am Your Mother"
videos.overview: A behind the scenes look at I Am Your Mother with Director Magdalena Osinska and the Aardman team.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "Journey to the Dark Head"
videos.overview: Behind the scenes of Journey to the Dark Head with Director Park Hyeong Geun & the Studio Mir team.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "The Spy Dancer"
videos.overview: Director Julien Chheng and the team at La Cachette discuss their short, The Spy Dancer.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "The Bandits of Golak"
videos.overview: An inside look at The Bandits of Golak with Director Ishan Shukla and the team at 88 Pictures.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "The Pit"
videos.overview: Behind the scenes of The Pit with Writer/Director LeAndre Thomas and D'ART Shtajio.

videos.title: Filmmaker Focus | "Aau's Song"
videos.overview: Directors Nadia Darries, Daniel Clarke, and the Triggerfish team take us behind Aau's Song.

videos.title: The Duel
videos.overview: A wandering stranger with a mysterious past defends a village from powerful bandits.

videos.title: Tatooine Rhapsody
videos.overview: A band with big dreams must save one of their own from Jabba the Hutt and Boba Fett.

videos.title: The Twins
videos.overview: Twins born into the dark side clash aboard a massive Star Destroyer.

videos.title: The Village Bride
videos.overview: A Jedi on the run takes in the unique customs of a remote village under threat by a warlord.

videos.title: The Ninth Jedi
videos.overview: The daughter of a lightsaber-smith is pursued by dark forces while on a dangerous mission.

videos.title: T0-B1
videos.overview: A cybernetic boy, who dreams of being a Jedi, discovers a dangerous truth about his creator.

videos.title: The Elder
videos.overview: A Jedi and his Padawan pursue a dark and powerful presence.

videos.title: Lop & Ochō
videos.overview: A family is torn about what to do when the Empire encroaches on their planet.

videos.title: Akakiri
videos.overview: A Jedi returns to his forbidden love to help defend her kingdom from a Sith-like Shogun.

videos.title: Sith
videos.overview: A former Sith apprentice finds their peaceful life threatened.

videos.title: Screecher's Reach
videos.overview: A young girl, out on an adventure with her friends, discovers a legendary cave with a dark pull.

videos.title: In the Stars
videos.overview: Two sisters, who are the last of their kind, fight for survival when Imperial forces discover them.

videos.title: I Am Your Mother
videos.overview: Young pilot Anni, embarrassed by her clingy mum, must team with her on a wild, madcap academy race.

videos.title: Journey to the Dark Head
videos.overview: A hopeful mechanic and disillusioned Jedi team up for an unlikely quest to turn the tide of war.

videos.title: The Spy Dancer
videos.overview: The premier dancer at an Imperial-frequented cabaret is tested when her identity is compromised.

videos.title: The Bandits of Golak
videos.overview: Pursued by the Empire, a boy and his force-sensitive younger sister seek refuge at a vibrant dhaba.

videos.title: The Pit
videos.overview: A young prisoner, forced to dig for kyber by the Empire, plans an escape for he and his people.

videos.title: Aau's Song
videos.overview: A child who longs to sing must stay quiet because her voice can cause great calamity in the mines.

videos.title: The Duel: Payback
videos.overview: With the help of unexpected allies, Ronin faces off against a twisted Jedi out for revenge.

videos.title: The Song of Four Wings
videos.overview: A princess-turned-rebel protects a child from the might of the Empire.

videos.title: The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope
videos.overview: Adrift in space and pursued by Jedi Hunters, Kara encounters a ship tended by a mysterious droid.

videos.title: The Bounty Hunters
videos.overview: A bounty hunter's job for a shady industrialist has unexpected consequences for her and her droid.

videos.title: Yuko's Treasure
videos.overview: A sheltered orphan teams up with a streetwise kid to rescue his droid and find a lost treasure.

videos.title: The Lost Ones
videos.overview: While helping refugees escape disaster, an incognito F is forced to confront the ghosts of her past.

videos.title: The Smuggler
videos.overview: Desperate for a quick payday, a smuggler takes a job to rescue a fugitive from the Empire.

videos.title: The Bird of Paradise
videos.overview: Blinded in battle, a Jedi padawan must undergo a series of spiritual trials to resist the Dark Side.

videos.title: BLACK
videos.overview: On the cusp of defeat, a psychedelic battle plays out in the haunted psyche of an Imperial trooper.
